label_rules_in_order: If soil moisture >= 60% OR rainfall >= 5 mm -> irrigation not required.
Else if soil moisture < 30% -> irrigation required.
Else if soil moisture < 45% AND temperature >= 34 C AND humidity < 45% AND rainfall < 1 mm -> irrigation required.
Then about 2% of labels are flipped at random.
note: This file was generated by generate_dataset.py for a college demonstration. It was not collected from a real farm.
